method: Observed rendered UI through the in-app browser, synthetic private local torrents; separate test engine/state.

checks.name: Invalid link correction
checks.detail: Invalid text shows an alert; correcting to a whitespace-padded HTTP torrent URL opens file/destination review and starts the isolated partial transfer.

checks.name: Multiple torrent file import
checks.detail: Selected two .torrent files through the browser file chooser. Alpha received review, then Bravo received a separate review, then both completed from pre-existing synthetic media.

checks.name: Limits save and cancellation
checks.detail: Saved 2.5 MB/s down and 0.75 MB/s up. Reopened and read both values. Edited to 9/9, canceled, reopened: 2.5/0.75 retained.

checks.name: Destructive choice reset
checks.detail: Checked Also delete downloaded files; closed with Close, reopened: unchecked. Repeated with Escape: unchecked. After backdrop fix, repeated by clicking outside the panel: unchecked. No downloaded file was deleted.

checks.name: Pause/resume keyboard continuity
checks.detail: Clicked Pause: state became Paused, focus stayed on Resume transfer. Pressed Enter: Downloading, focus returned to Pause transfer.

checks.name: Card context-menu focus
checks.detail: Right-click opened Show file with focus on the menu item. Escape closed it and restored focus to the same card. Native file-manager reveal is covered by prior v0.2 evidence, not re-observed here.

checks.name: Dialog focus loop
checks.detail: After correction: Tab from last OK loops to Close; Shift+Tab from Close loops to OK; Escape returns focus to Setup. Verified in the 445px visible browser.

checks.name: Both finishes and narrow layout
checks.detail: Observed Ivory and Obsidian at 1280px and 445px. No document overflow. Header utility keys 62x52; narrow transfer keys 186x52; Tape Deck Play 96x96.

limits: Native VLC file pickers, Save export, drag/reorder and device audio were not directly operated.
No public torrent swarm, screen-reader session, hardware/high-DPI or suspend test.
Screenshots show real browser frames; the internally scrolling card list is not a stitched full-list view.
fixed_after_observation: Modal overlay did not dismiss by clicking outside the panel.
Tab could leave the dialog for browser chrome.
test_harness_corrections: Dummy audio does not provide a meaningful device-volume readback; volume remains unverified.
VLC HTTP routes register at startup; test-only reorder template moved before launch.
Installed VLC sort accepts the title key despite older numeric README examples.
Playlist parsing is asynchronous; wait for imported children before asserting order.
